# Magnifying Glass Containing Footprints — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_27/monitoring activity tracking 2_3932acf9-d8a9-4dab-a9e2-4e0a52270bc7.svg`
- source UUID: `3932acf9-d8a9-4dab-a9e2-4e0a52270bc7`
- classification: container_combination
- review: component_briefs_ready

A complete circular magnifier surrounds two distinct footprint glyphs. The lens acts as an enclosure for the tracking content.

## Visual draft

A round magnifying lens contains two separated footprint shapes, each formed by a long oval sole and smaller heel mark. A straight handle extends diagonally downward from the lower right edge.

## 1. Empty handled magnifying lens (container)

A round magnifying lens joins a straight handle extending diagonally down to the right. Exclude all footprint shapes from the lens.

## 2. Pair of footprints (sub)

Two separate footprints each contain a long tilted oval sole and a small rounded heel mark. Exclude the magnifying lens and handle.
